name: Open Waters Charts
description: Open Waters' nautical-style maps as basemaps: Seamap (depths, seamarks, lights and sectors, traffic separation schemes and hazards) and Seascape (seafloor depth shading, contours and soundings from global open bathymetry). Not for navigation.
author: Milo

commands.label: Seamap
commands.help: Use Open Waters' Seamap as the basemap: depths, seamarks, lights and hazards. Not for navigation: consult official charts.
commands.params: {"add"?: bool (stack it over the current basemaps instead of replacing them)}

commands.label: Seascape Chart
commands.help: Use Open Waters' Seascape as the basemap: a chart of the seafloor with depth shading, contours and soundings. Not for navigation: consult official charts.
commands.params: {"add"?: bool (stack it over the current basemaps instead of replacing them), "unit"?: "m" | "ft" | "fm" (depth unit, default m), "safety"?: number (shade water shallower than this many metres as a hazard, default 2), "shading"?: "relief" | "bands" (continuous shading or depth-area bands, default relief)}

commands.label: Seascape Relief
commands.help: Seascape as shaded relief of land and seafloor together.
commands.params: {"add"?: bool (stack it over the current basemaps instead of replacing them)}

commands.label: Seascape Hillshade
commands.help: Seascape as grey hillshading of the seafloor alone, with land in flat grey.
commands.params: {"add"?: bool (stack it over the current basemaps instead of replacing them)}

commands.label: Seascape Topo
commands.help: Seascape as a red-to-blue depth tint with labelled metric contours, in the style of survey and fishing charts.
commands.params: {"add"?: bool (stack it over the current basemaps instead of replacing them)}

Remove
Charts
commands.help: Take the Open Waters maps off the map.

items.help: Open Waters' Seascape: the seafloor from global open bathymetry, as a chart or in other views.
